name: Assault Nurse ~Angels in a Spermcoat~ Karte1
original_name: アサルトナース ～Angels in a spermcoat～ Karte1
source:
Nurses battle the mad doctor they call "humanity's cancer" - 'Assault Nurses'

But self-hatred twists these warriors, warps them into puppets that dance to its tune.
Will they cut out the sickness before it spreads?
Or will they become the very plague that devours mankind?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201217145639/https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_172473/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
护士们与被他们称为“人类癌症”的疯狂医生作斗争——“突击护士”

但自我仇恨扭曲了这些战士，将他们扭曲成随波逐流的傀儡。
他们会在疾病蔓延之前消灭它吗？
或者它们会成为吞噬人类的瘟疫吗？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201217145639/https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_172473/]DMM[/url]]
